comment: Hy4-flash gate prompts (G2 / G3 identity). Original project-owned text, raw completion prompts (no chat template, no BOS: the pack declares tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token = false). Ids: <id>.ids, one id per line, produced by the shared tokenizer (strix-tokenize PACK encode). G4 quality reuses scripts/bench/prompts/kit.json plus gate-zh.
